text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This summer, Transcend's heart was leaning more toward relief activities."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, they were training seriously—anyone could see that.
And in the midst of it all—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hm, a message?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh? This is... from those kids...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wait... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Everyone... why...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm genuinely surprised. I just got a message from the local girls.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, a whole lot of people said
they were bummed they couldn't see my race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I show Transcend the local reactions from the news site I was reading on my phone.
There, it says—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I really wished they could have at least held the Mile Championship Nambu Hai."
"I went every year, so it's kinda rough..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to cheer together with my friends!"
"Next year for sure!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Surprisingly, there were people placing their hopes on me.
I honestly thought everyone had far more pressing things to worry about...
choice_data_list: Yeah, there are probably a lot of different opinions...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are tons of people here.
At the very least, it doesn't seem like all of them are against racing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... you know...
It wasn't like this back in spring..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now that summer's passed, it feels like the air's
starting to change a bit.
Compared to back then and now...
choice_data_list: It might be... a turning point soon.
It might be... a turning point soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You can't truly understand the subtle feelings of the locals unless you're actually there.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Lately...
all the support has only been from afar...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand as much as I thought I did...
If I can't be there for her, then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm heading back north again soon!
choice_data_list: OK, then that's tickets for two.
OK, then tickets for two it is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that goes without saying.
Come on, with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I'll go see for myself.
Along with Transcend, what the "present" is like over there.
